what: On interaction, the English menu letters pop up 3px one by one at .05s intervals and drop back in place half a beat later — with no in-between values (steps), they jump as if hand-stamped. This plays once per re-hover. The ”smooth” type: per text line (English label · two big lines), letters rise .3em in turn at .05s over .2s linear and settle, the text tints to the accent color over .3s, and the sprout graphic (bud) behind the link grows from .4x to 1x, rising to 3.5em above the text (.35s cubic-bezier(.285,1.02,.525,1.13) — slight overshoot, then settle)

options.dur: Duration of a single-letter bounce (seconds), default .5 — floats during the latter half (smooth type default .2)
options.hop: Lift height (CSS length), default 3px (smooth type is .3em)
options.look: With ‹smooth› it rises straight, settles back, tints with the accent color and a bud sprouts (Brand). With ‹smooth still› the color stays and only the jump happens (Brand bookmark table of contents)
options.[data-fx-part=letters]: (optional) lines of text to split — if several, counting restarts from 0 per line. If absent, the whole text of the element
options.[data-fx-part=bud]: (smooth type, if any) a small graphic that hides behind the link and then rises. Rise height is the css variable --fx-bud-rise (default 3.5em)

use: EventEvent · smooth: ConceptMenu 1
